global_fields.name: m

pair_item_fields.name: distance

global_fields.name: m

pair_item_fields.name: from_id

pair_item_fields.name: to_id

global_fields.name: m

pair_item_fields.name: from_id

pair_item_fields.name: from_id

pair_item_fields.name: to_id

pair_item_fields.name: distance

global_fields.name: m

pair_item_fields.name: from_id

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the second candidate in a pair used to reference a pairwise profile comparison.

pair_item_fields.name: distance

global_fields.name: m

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the first country in a country-pair; used together with country_to_id to locate the pair's distinctiveness score.

pair_item_fields.name: to_id

pair_item_fields.name: distance
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric measure of how different the two referenced countries are (the 'how different' score); when both countries are selected, this value contributes to the lineup's total diversity score.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of fabric swatches offered to the designer — the size of the candidate pool to choose from.

global_fields.name: nodes

global_fields.name: m
global_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of swatches the designer must pick for the compact collection; the final selection must contain exactly this many unique swatches.

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the first swatch in a pair used to report their stylistic comparison.

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the second swatch in a pair used to report their stylistic comparison.

pair_item_fields.name: distance

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of artworks available to choose from for the spotlight exhibit (the pool size n).

global_fields.name: nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: List of unique identifiers for each artwork in the pool; these IDs are referenced in pairwise dissimilarity records and in the final selection.

global_fields.name: m
global_fields.scenario_description: Exact number of artworks the curator must pick for the exhibit (the value m). The solution must select this many distinct artwork IDs.

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the first artwork in a compared pair; used together with artwork_id_b to locate the pair's dissimilarity.

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the second artwork in the compared pair; paired with artwork_id_a to represent the two artworks whose difference is measured.

pair_item_fields.name: distance
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric measure of how different the two artworks are (higher = more stylistically/thematically different). These values are summed over all pairs within the selected set to evaluate its diversity.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of neighborhoods available on the planning map (size of the candidate pool).

global_fields.name: nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: The list of identifiers (names or codes) for each neighborhood the organizer can choose from.

global_fields.name: m
global_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of distinct neighborhoods the organizer must pick for outreach events (the tour must include exactly this many neighborhoods).

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the first neighborhood in a pair; used with neighborhood_id_b to reference a specific pair when scoring how spread out the chosen set is.

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the second neighborhood in a pair; paired with neighborhood_id_a to define the pair whose separation contributes to the diversity score.

pair_item_fields.name: distance
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The measured distance or dissimilarity between the two neighborhoods (e.g., kilometers or travel time). For any candidate set, these pairwise distances are summed over all chosen pairs to compute how far-flung the selected neighborhoods are.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of distinct films the programming crew may choose from when assembling the shorts block.

global_fields.name: nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: An ordered list of identifiers (IDs or short titles) for every available film; selections must be drawn from these identifiers.

global_fields.name: m
global_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of films the programmer must pick for the shorts block — the lineup must contain exactly this many distinct film IDs.

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the first film in a pair used to reference a pairwise dissimilarity entry (one endpoint of a film pair).

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the second film in a pair used to reference a pairwise dissimilarity entry (the other endpoint of a film pair).

pair_item_fields.name: distance
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric dissimilarity score between the two referenced films (higher means more thematic/stylistic contrast); these scores are summed over all unordered pairs inside the chosen m-film lineup to measure its overall variety.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct wines in the pool that the sommelier can choose from for the tasting flight.

global_fields.name: nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers (IDs or labels) for each wine in the pool; each corresponds to a unique bottle or wine option that may be selected.

global_fields.name: m
global_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of wines the sommelier must pick for the comparative tasting flight (the selection size constraint).

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the first wine in a pair whose taste dissimilarity is recorded (one end of a pairwise distance entry).

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the second wine in a pair whose taste dissimilarity is recorded (the other end of a pairwise distance entry).

pair_item_fields.name: distance
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Numerical measure of taste dissimilarity between the two wines (how far apart their flavor profiles are); these pairwise values are summed over all pairs inside the chosen flight to evaluate diversity.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of available languages in the dataset — the size of the pool from which the researcher can choose the shortlist.

global_fields.name: nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: A list of identifiers for each language (e.g., ISO codes or names). These are the unique labels used to reference languages in pairwise distance entries.

global_fields.name: m
global_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of languages the researcher must select for the comparative study. The final selection must contain exactly this many distinct language identifiers.

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the first language in a language pair. Used together with language_id_b to locate the precomputed dissimilarity between the two languages.

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the second language in a language pair. Pairs (language_id_a, language_id_b) refer to the two languages whose linguistic distance is given.

pair_item_fields.name: distance
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The precomputed numeric measure of how different the two languages are. For any shortlisted set, the researcher's objective is to maximize the sum of these values over all unordered pairs inside the shortlist.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct color palettes available to choose from for the release.

global_fields.name: nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers (IDs or names) for each available color palette; these are the candidates you may pick from.

global_fields.name: m
global_fields.scenario_description: Exactly how many palettes the product team must pick for the update (the fixed size of the selection).

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the first palette in a pair whose dissimilarity is recorded.

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the second palette in the pair; together with palette_id_a defines the pair whose difference is measured.

pair_item_fields.name: distance
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric measure of how different the two palettes are (higher means more visually distinct). These pairwise values are summed over all pairs inside a chosen set to score its overall diversity.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of candidate shelter locations available to choose from. This tells the planner how many unique sites appear in the distance data.

global_fields.name: nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: List of unique identifiers (names or IDs) for each candidate shelter location; these are the items you may select as primary sites.

global_fields.name: m
global_fields.scenario_description: The exact number of shelters that must be designated primary. The solver must choose exactly this many distinct shelter_ids.

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the first shelter in a pair used to define a distance entry; pairs are considered unordered for the diversity sum but each entry links two specific shelter_ids.

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the second shelter in a pair for this distance entry; used together with shelter_id_a to locate the pairwise separation between two candidate sites.

pair_item_fields.name: distance
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: The geographic separation (distance or dissimilarity) between the two shelters (shelter_id_a and shelter_id_b). These values are summed for every pair inside a chosen set to evaluate how dispersed the selected primary sites are.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct apple varieties available to choose from for the trial block.

global_fields.name: nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers (names or IDs) for each available apple variety that can be planted in the trial; each ID corresponds to a row/entry in the distance data.

global_fields.name: m
global_fields.scenario_description: Exact number of different apple varieties the orchard manager must select for the trial block; the chosen set must contain exactly this many unique varieties.

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for the first apple variety in a pairwise distance record; must match one of the IDs listed in 'variety_ids'.

pair_item_fields.name: to_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for the second apple variety in a pairwise distance record; must match one of the IDs listed in 'variety_ids'.

pair_item_fields.name: distance
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric measure of dissimilarity between the two named varieties (combining genetic and trait differences). When evaluating a trial selection, these distances are summed over all unique pairs among the chosen varieties to score diversity.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of available art media (the size of the full pool the teacher can choose from).

global_fields.name: m

pair_item_fields.name: from_id
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the first art medium in a measured pair whose perceived difference to another medium is recorded.

pair_item_fields.name: to_id

pair_item_fields.name: distance
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric measure of how different the two media feel (higher = more different). These pairwise scores are summed over all pairs inside the chosen set to evaluate curriculum diversity.
